name: travelmate-ai
description: TravelMate AI - full-stack app (Node/Express + SQLite backend, React/Vite frontend)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
